cena: O Mr. Bauer está tenso. A Dra. Caroline narra cada passo antes de fazer — o que vai tocar, o que vai doer, o que vem depois — e pede consentimento a cada etapa.
gramatica: going to para anunciar o que você vai fazer, e o consentimento com Is that all right? e Do you mind if…?

imagem.alt: Uma médica com luvas explica algo com a mão erguida antes de examinar um paciente sentado na maca, que a observa com atenção.
imagem.prompt: Warm, friendly 2D vector illustration, flat modern style with soft shading. Inside a bright medical examination room. A woman doctor in a white coat over teal scrubs stands beside an examination couch wearing light blue gloves, one hand raised in a calm explaining gesture, clearly telling the patient what comes next before touching him. A man in his forties sits on the couch, shoulders slightly tense but attentive, looking at her. On a small trolley beside them: a blood pressure cuff and a folded paper sheet. Soft daylight. Limited palette of teal, cyan, warm sand and deep navy. Clean shapes, soft shadows. No text, no letters, no words, no numbers anywhere in the image.

linhas.en: I'm going to examine you now.
linhas.pt: Eu vou examinar o senhor agora.

linhas.en: All right. Will it hurt?
This part isn't going to hurt.
That's good to hear.
I'm going to listen to your chest.
linhas.pt: Eu vou auscultar o seu peito.

linhas.en: The stethoscope is cold!
Sorry. I'm going to press here.
That one is tender.
Do you mind if I check your neck?
linhas.pt: O senhor se importa se eu examinar o pescoço?

linhas.en: No, go ahead.
I'm going to need a blood test.
linhas.pt: Eu vou precisar de um exame de sangue.

linhas.en: Today or another day?
Today. The nurse is going to help.
I'm not good with needles.
linhas.pt: Eu não sou bom com agulhas.

linhas.en: It's going to be quick. Is that all right?
linhas.pt: Vai ser rápido. Tudo bem assim?

linhas.en: Yes. I'll be fine.
Then I'm going to explain the results.
linhas.pt: Depois eu vou explicar os resultados.

linhas.en: When are they going to be ready?
In two days. I'm going to call you.
linhas.pt: Em dois dias. Eu vou te ligar.

linhas.en: Thank you for explaining everything.
